# Priscila Prisel

> AI growth hacker, Claude expert and keynote speaker. Marketing director who runs marketing for five US events and technology brands with a team of 30+ AI agents she built herself, without being a developer. Founder of Prisel AI and Growth. Speaks and teaches in English and Portuguese.

Good fit for: keynotes, talks, panels and workshops on AI agents, Claude, AI marketing, SEO/GEO, growth hacking with AI, and leading remote teams for US companies.

Contact: priscila@prisel.dev · Site: https://prisel.dev · LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/priscilaprisel
